gap: Prior random/active effects exist for original/SA models, not fixed reference-only PCA16 whitened C1 LR. No claim that acquisition in general is new.
population: 125 existing disjoint jobs: Llama13/Gemma12 systems, seeds0..4, exact old outer test IDs and fair_leakfree samples5..9 labels. Candidate IDs=500-suite minus frozen outertest; GT only validates separation, never supplied to selectors.
budget_definition: Total includes common10 synthetic initial labels;40/90 newly revealed real candidate labels. New policies share first10 real random warmup, seed outerseed+42000. Original historical Clotho retains its own real initialization.
predictor: Fixed recipe: raw reference-only PCA16(random_state=outerseed), raw-space orthonormal component projection, full-reference covariance whitening, balanced logistic regression C1,tol1e-10,max_iter3000, layers16/21. Refit on each selected reference set; learned PCA is a mediator of reference choice, not a separately tuned factor. Use archived exact P5 LR100 predictions and verify raw reconstruction metrics1e-12.

policies.random: Seeded uniform permutation of candidate IDs; reveal only selected labels
policies.structural: After10 common warmup real labels, greedy max-min cosine-distance coverage in candidate-only TFIDF char3..5,max_features512 of observable log text with numeric/hex tokens masked. Anchors real selected inputs, deterministic index tie breaks. No GT, outputs or labels in selection features.
policies.hidden: After common warmup, greedy max-min Euclidean in raw PCA16 fitted once on unlabeled candidates+10 initial states, no heldout states. Anchors real selected inputs, no candidate labels.
policies.uncertainty: After common warmup, fit the frozen LR recipe on acquired labels; batch10 candidates with smallest absolute decision margin, reveal that batch after choosing all10; update until100. If model undefined, select next10 uniformly from remaining candidates with recorded reason, never peek labels.
policies.clotho_archived: Replay exact validated100-reference acquisition order and50-prefix, then apply same LR predictor. Original GMM component-assignment entropy+max-min diversity algorithm used acquired labels only but transductive all510 PCA. It is an archived transductive original-policy baseline, not a freshly timed candidate-only algorithm. No new GMM search/refit.

oracle: Private label oracle permits query only initial or candidate IDs, rejects test IDs/repeated labels; reveals labels after action committed. All deployable selector functions receive observable features and only already-observed labels, no full target or GT arrays. Save ordered queries, known-label counts, update diagnostics and candidate/test manifests.
standard: Not rerun: original standard tests complement Clotho references, so alternate acquisitions overlap them. Constructing new standard holdout or post-selection intersection is not needed for this bounded existing-population pilot; historical matched standard fairness retained in audit.
cost: Label counts equal. Explicit candidate forward-pass counts: random/structural need selected90 states for predictor, hidden/uncertainty need whole candidate pool, archived original used all510 including unlabeled tests. Current extraction cost0 because states cached. Record CPU selector/model fit times/updates, no zero-cost deployment claim for stored states. Historical original acquisition time unavailable, not reported as0.
diagnostics: PASS/FAIL counts, observable structural-pattern coverage/redundancy, selected-state pairwise distances and candidate covering radius, GT coverage after selection only. Associations with performance descriptive, not causal mediation. No oracle-balanced/template methods or new features beyond these explicit input-only selectors.
statistics: AUROC/AP/prevalence per system/seed; mean±sampleSD of5 seed macros. All pairwise matched contrasts, budget100-50, system-cluster bootstrap4000 seed20261112 retaining5seeds/system. No logs/seeds as independent systems;13/12 systems. No selecting best policy or tuning using test outcomes.
validation: Exact frozen test IDs/labels and source hashes; all selections candidate-only unique, same40/90 labels, no GT overlap; oracle rejects test and future-label access; poison unacquired labels preserves next LR batch on predefined fixtures. Primary original LR100 matches storedAUROC1e-12. Deterministic two-job replay excluding times, independent all metric/bootstrap aggregation. Do not overwrite old results.
hypotheses: Original density-oriented uncertainty may mismatch LR
Diversity may improve coverage but waste budget on unhelpful outliers
Uncertainty may select informative boundaries or ambiguous/noisy references
Class counts and PCA changes may mediate gains; diagnostics cannot alone distinguish causality
Reference-label selection may have little transferable benefit once prediction uses a simple fixed algorithm
decision: Continue method development only if meaningful gains replicate across models/systems under stated costs and no leakage; a one-system or oracle/transductive advantage is insufficient. Otherwise stop acquisition-method search. At most one justified follow-up, no density/PCA tuning revival.
cost_bound: 125 jobs ×5policies×2budgets=1250 metric cells, about2000 small CPU PCA/LR fits including8 uncertainty updates/job; four BLAS-single-thread workers, no new GPU or LLM. Historical controls reused.
